description: This file defines a PHP class 'JobTitleAPI' which serves as a REST API endpoint for managing job titles in an HR management system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting job title records, along with validation rules and annotations for API documentation using OpenAPI. The class interacts with service layers and data models related to job titles and their specifications.

classes.name: JobTitleAPI
classes.description: A PHP class extending Endpoint that provides REST API operations for managing Job Title entities in the HR system, including CRUD operations, validation rules, and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the JobTitleService instance used for business logic related to job titles.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific JobTitle by ID. Returns a resource result or throws RecordNotFoundException.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, primarily checking that ID parameter is valid.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all Job Titles, with optional filtering and sorting. Returns a collection result.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing Job Titles, including filters and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new Job Title. Sets data from request, handles attachment, and returns created resource.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Populates a JobTitle entity with data from request parameters.

methods.name: setJobSpecification
methods.description: Attaches a Base64-encoded file as a JobSpecificationAttachment to a JobTitle.

methods.name: getBase64JobSpecification
methods.description: Retrieves the Base64Attachment object from request if present.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules specific to creating a JobTitle, including uniqueness and lengths.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Returns validation rules for common body fields, used in create and update.

methods.name: getJobTitleCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates an EntityUniquePropertyOption, ignoring deleted titles, for validation.

methods.name: getSpecificationRule
methods.description: Provides validation rule for the specification attachment.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing JobTitle, managing specification attachments and special parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a JobTitle, including handling of current job spec option.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to delete one or more JobTitles by IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation, primarily checking IDs.
